text_block_list.text:
—The day of the Debut Race finally arrived.
I had secretly invited some very special guests for today...!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: —Yuki-chan! We made it!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wh-Whaaat?! Holy moly!!

text_block_list.name: Villagers
text_block_list.text:
Yukino-chaaan! We came all this way to cheer ya on! Give 'em hell today!
Ooh, look at ya, it's been ages! My, haven't you grown so big!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
E-Everyone?! Ma, Pa, you too?! What're you all doin' here?!
Awawa, what's with that glittery gold banner of yours, gansu~~~?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... Your Trainer got in touch with us, you see?
So the whole village decided to come out and cheer you on.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
A surprise...! That's so sophisticated of you... I was so startled.
But... ahaha! My nerves are all gone now! Thank you so much, gansu!

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek! It's Yukino Bijin-chan!
You're so adorable today too! We're rooting for you~~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I went and bought the Yukino-chan plushie~!
She already has official merch, she's seriously such an idol~!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Yuki-chan, you're super popular! That's amazing!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh! This is just a fad...
I don't deserve this kind of hype...

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Yuki-chan... I don't think you need to worry so much.
I mean, being trendy isn't a bad thing...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Tons of people have gotten to know you and want to cheer for you now.
Since everyone's watching, this is your chance to show them what you can really do.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Hype and luck matter a lot! If nobody knows who you are,
nothing can even begin. ...Hype is an opportunity!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...! H-Hype is... an opportunity...
choice_data_list: That's right, this hype might lead to a bright future.
That's right, this hype might lead to a bright future.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: A future...? What kind of future would that be?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...No, that's completely up to me to decide, isn't it...?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Here I was, mopin' around thinkin' "it's just a fad"...
When havin' people's eyes on me is somethin' I oughta be mighty grateful for...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna win! Folks from the village, my fans, my Trainer...
Everyone, please... watch me run...!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
—And sitting at 9th favorite is this girl, Yukino Bijin.
Let's see what this adorable "country belle" horsegirl can do today!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Well, making the top five would be a miracle for her. But for an idol horsegirl,
that's plenty. Just having her in the race builds hype, after all.

text_block_list.name: Villagers
text_block_list.text: Grrrgh~~~...?!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Yuki-chan is gonna win...! She's not just some "pretty face"!
She's a horsegirl packed with pure Morioka grit! Everyone! Let her hear you!

text_block_list.name: Villagers
text_block_list.text: YEAAAAHHH!!
And the gates open...!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my! Yukino Bijin has secured a great position!
Can she keep up with the leaders from here?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You bet! Here I go! I ain't givin' up this spot—!!
...Haaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
She passed them...?! 
Wait, look at how quickly she's pulling away from the pack behind her...?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose, I won't lose...!
I've gotta win right here, right now...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I wanna stand on that side too! Stand tall alongside those sparkly horsegirls,
as someone strong, and cute—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna become... a stylish...!
"CITYYY GIRRRRL"!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin! Yukino Bijin cannot be stopped!
What a ferocious finishing sprint!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
She holds the lead! Yukino Bijin pulls away
by a commanding three lengths and takes the WINNN!!!

text_block_list.name: Villagers
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOAAAHHH!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah...! Wheeeew!
I-I did it! I won, gansu~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
No way...! She actually won...!
She was like a completely different person... Wait, is that the real Yukino Bijin...?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Holy smokes! Who knew she had that kind of speed in her?
What in the world is in the water with these regional horsegirls lately?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Ehehe! Look at 'em all flabbergasted...!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Yuki-chan! You were truly, truly incredible...!
It gave me so much courage. I'm gonna give figure skating my all too!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
...Um, Trainer-san.
Please take good care of Yuki-chan from now on!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Father
text_block_list.text:
We're countin' on ya too, please. This lass is the hope of our whole village, gansu.
Please look after her for a good long while.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
M-Mifuyu-chan! Dad, not you too...!
U-Um... they're only helpin' me with trainin' for now, so...
choice_data_list: If you'd have me, I want to sign a formal contract with you!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
J-Jajaaah?! A-Are you sure...?
I mean... that's like a dream come true for me, but...!
choice_data_list: Let's aim to make you the ultimate "city girl" together!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...! Yes...! I promise you,
I'll become the most stylish "city girl" there ever was!
